text: Oh, absolutely. I don’t use those archaic, industrial-grade metal files or even the quaint little wooden sticks of the past. No, I rely on the cutting-edge technology of a high-pressure jet of boiling lava, which I carefully aim at my molars while holding my breath for forty-five seconds. It’s the only way to ensure that the structural integrity of my enamel is completely compromised in record time. Why bother with gentle bristles when you can achieve total dental annihilation with the efficiency of a demolition crew? It’s truly the epitome of oral hygiene: why preserve your teeth when you can simply vaporize them with the force of a volcanic eruption?
